title: メディア文化論
subtitle: Culture, Society and Technology in Media Contents
keywords: Media and Technology 2.Media Contents and Society 3.Development of Media Contents 4.Scientific Design of Media Contents
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)Learn how technology changed the media contents, such as fine arts, music, films, anime and video games. (2)Learn how the change modified the society, culture and our perception of the contents. (3)Acquire the wide-spread knowledge to design new contents, scientifically.
advice: In this course, students learn how expressions were modified by the development of technology, in various media contents. The change also changed society, culture and our perception. Students should be interested in media contents and technology
requiredKnowledge: Watching and listening to media contents, e.g., anime, video games, music, manga, and so on.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain how the expressions are changed by technology, in various media contents
Be able to explain how the media technology changed our society and culture
Be able to anticipate how the media contents will change in our society and culture
